map.大棚卷膜时间建议器 使用指南: Greenhouse Film Rolling Time Advisor User Guide
map.大棚卷膜时机建议器，综合温度、风速、湿度等判断卷放膜时机，辅助温室环境调控与作物: Greenhouse film rolling timing advisor: judges when to roll the film up or down from temperature, wind speed, humidity and other factors, for greenhouse climate control and crop protection.
map.分级判定：棚温 &gt; 作物耐温上限 → 立即卷膜；棚温 &gt; 目标温 +: Grading decision: greenhouse temperature > crop heat tolerance limit means roll up immediately; greenhouse temperature > target temperature + 3 C means rolling up is advised; humidity > 85% means roll up a little to vent; otherwise hold
map.按时段（早/午/晚）与温度、湿度、风速分档给出卷放膜建议，非单一公式。核心阈值：: Advice is given in tiers by time of day (morning/midday/evening) together with temperature, humidity and wind speed, rather than by a single formula. Core thresholds: above the crop heat tolerance limit is emergency ventilation; more than 3 C above the target temperature means ventilation is advised; humidity above 85% needs dehumidifying; when wind speed is too high it suggests using the small top vents to release air slowly to avoid damaging the film. The result gives an action (roll up / roll down / hold), an urgency level and the reason, for greenhouse climate control reference.
map.按棚内温度/湿度目标与室外气象建议卷膜（通风）时段。: Suggest film rolling (ventilation) times from the greenhouse temperature/humidity targets and outside weather.
map.冬季午间高温短时卷膜排湿，夏季早晚大通风降温。: In winter roll the film up briefly around midday when it is warm to vent humidity; in summer ventilate strongly morning and evening to cool down.
map.用于缓解棚内高湿引发的病害。: For relieving diseases triggered by high humidity in the greenhouse.
map.：棚内湿度 95%、温度 25℃（超高湿），室外 8℃、微风。建议 10:00~: : Greenhouse humidity 95% and temperature 25 C (very high humidity), outside 8 C with a light breeze. Advice: roll the film up one third from 10:00 to 11:30 to vent for 30 minutes, bringing humidity below 80% before closing again to keep warmth, avoiding all-day high humidity that triggers disease.
map.为什么冬季也要卷膜？: Why roll the film up in winter too?
map.冬季密闭棚内夜间呼吸+蒸腾使湿度极高，是灰霉、霜霉爆发温床。午间短时通风排湿比一: In a sealed greenhouse in winter, respiration plus transpiration at night drives humidity very high, a breeding ground for grey mould and downy mildew. Short midday ventilation to remove moisture matters more than keeping heat at all costs; the key is 'vent moisture without over-cooling'.
map.大风天能卷膜吗？: Can the film be rolled up on a windy day?
map.应减小开度或择时。强风卷膜易损伤棚膜、灌冷风闪苗。关注风速预警，5 级以上建议只: Reduce the opening or choose another time. Rolling film in strong wind easily damages the film and lets in cold drafts that shock the seedlings. Watch wind speed warnings; at level 5 or above, only open the top vents slightly.
